annotation.summary: A man turns toward a new attraction while his current partner looks offended.
annotation.visual: A man in a blue plaid shirt looks back at a woman in red. The woman walking beside him reacts with disbelief.
annotation.mechanism: Labeling people as priorities turns a familiar relationship scene into a joke about abandoning an existing commitment for something new.
scenarios: Get excited about a new framework before finishing the current project
Buy another book while unread books pile up
Chase a new hobby while neglecting an established one

examples.why: The new tool gets attention while the existing work is neglected.

avoid: The labels must distinguish the new attraction from the existing commitment.
annotation.basis: Creative interpretation based on inspected source media; not a verified account of historical origin.
